summary: This 8-K reports the auction of substantially all assets of Fat Brands Inc. and Twin Hospitality Group Inc., following their Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing on January 26, 2026. The Bankruptcy Court approved bidding procedures on April 9, 2026; the auction was held April 27, 2026. Provisional winners included FBG Bid Co. LLC for FAT Brands assets and Amazing Brands, LLC for HDOS assets. Exact terms (price per share, premium, implied value) are not stated in the excerpt. No board recommendation or advisor named. The sale is subject to Bankruptcy Court approval; a hearing to approve the sale is scheduled. What to watch: final court approval, potential competing bids, and closing timeline.
